  "booked_by" text NOT NULL,
  "cancel_reason" text,
  "cancelled_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deducted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "pass_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slot_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'booked' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_pl_booking_cancel_91095971" CHECK ((status LIKE 'cancelled\_%') = (cancelled_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_pl_booking_deduct_be43e02f" CHECK ((status NOT IN ('cancelled_instructor', 'cancelled_member_free') OR deducted = false) AND (status NOT IN ('cancelled_member_late', 'no_show', 'done') OR deducted = true)),
  CONSTRAINT "private_lesson_bookings_booked_by_check_6bde91c0" CHECK ("booked_by" IN ('instructor', 'member')),
  CONSTRAINT "private_lesson_bookings_status_check_6a132a04" CHECK ("status" IN ('booked', 'done', 'cancelled_instructor', 'cancelled_member_free', 'cancelled_member_late', 'no_show'))
)

execute.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist

  EXCLUDE USING gist (instructor_account_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) WITH &&)
  WHERE (status IN ('open', 'held', 'booked'))

ALTER TABLE public.private_lesson_slots ADD CONSTRAINT ex_pl_slots_room
  EXCLUDE USING gist (room_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) WITH &&)
  WHERE (status IN ('open', 'held', 'booked') AND room_id IS NOT NULL)
